content: Self healing test automation: on failure due to UI drift such as renamed or moved elements, AI finds the correct element via alternate strategies including nearby text, ARIA labels, DOM structure, visual similarity, or fuzzy attribute matching instead of hard failing. Categories include selector healing, timing healing, visual assertion healing that filters irrelevant diffs, and interaction change healing. Visual regression AI flags meaningful pixel or layout diffs while ignoring noise. Widely offered across Testim, mabl, QA Wolf, Reflect.
